tei:bibl.tei:title: Blessing for Rosh Ḥodesh Ḥeshvan, by Kohenet Ilana Joy Streit
tei:bibl.tei:author: Kohenet Ilana Joy Streit
tei:bibl.tei:note: Converted from the export of opensiddur.org at 624215eef0.

tei:div.tei:p: A poem-blessing for the Hebrew month of Ḥeshvan, suitable for Birkat HaḤodesh and for Rosh Ḥodesh Ḥeshvan itself. Also to be kept in the pocket of Jewish communal leaders during Elul and Tishrei.
Please note that this was written in the Northern Hemisphere and conveys the experience of Ḥeshvan as an autumn month.

If this piece brings you comfort, nourishment or inspiration, please consider making a financial contribution to support this work. You can see and hear more of Ilana’s creative work on her Patreon page. Or to make a one-time contribution, Venmo (@Ilana-Streit).
